DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penile and Cutaneous).

Based on the biopsy and histopathology results confirming cellular atypia and invasion, combined with your history of heavy smoking and chronic non-healing lesions, the clinical picture is consistent with Squamous Cell Carcinoma. The presence of lesions in both the genital and cutaneous regions, along with the lack of response to prior treatments, supports this diagnosis.
